description: Portable PGO+ThinLTO build of the UNMODIFIED official Lean 4.37.0-rc1 sources for the tier-2 build path: lean --version identical to the release; .olean/.ilean of Mathlib modules byte-identical to the official lean in an A/B comparison; needs GLIBC_2.25 (getentropy, weak) and no libstdc++/gmp/uv/ssl from the host (sound build only, untrusted). Findings that apply to ANY rebuild of the release sources: 020 (core-library .olean headers carry the stage0 version/githash), 037 (CHECK_OLEAN_VERSION=OFF as in every rebuild), 050 (native frame sizes / stack-overflow band), 061 (build configuration: static libstdc++/GMP/libuv/OpenSSL, leanc flags); the patch-specific 004 014 040 046 048 do not apply (no source change)
name: lean4-v4.37.0-rc1-pgo-portable
source: official Lean v4.37.0-rc1 sources (github leanprover/lean4 tag v4.37.0-rc1 = 0b77e12952ad39077d80d8bd6b66d601f225c321, NO source change) + PGO/LTO CMake hooks ported to 4.37 (toolchains/portable-recipe/v4.37/port-pgo-lto.py, build system only) + githash pinned to 0b77e129, -DLEAN_SPECIAL_VERSION_DESC=rc1 -DLEAN_PLATFORM_TARGET=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; clang frontend PGO profile pgo/lean.profdata sha256 2d9ed39c... trained on 1,000 Mathlib 31ce06ea modules; ThinLTO; portable recipe (manylinux_2_28 root, conda clang/lld 18.1.8, gcc-toolset-13 libstdc++ static+hidden with a WEAK getentropy reference, the 4.37 release static GMP 6.3.0/libuv 1.53.0/OpenSSL 4.1.0, glibc-2.17 libm at link time, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH 1795000338); toolchains/portable-recipe
